comparison.objective: Rotate a constrained parcel 90° in place without translating it or disturbing adjacent boxes.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated opposing bimanual pushes near the parcel ends; no tool use, impact fracture, or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Parcel orientation achieved while center drift stays ≤4 cm and neighboring-box motion ≤1 cm.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled planar rotation of a large object, not coaxial mandrel placement, hammer-induced notch fracture, retained-coil protection, and recovery of free tangs. No spec versions were provided.
